reasoning: The icon combines a chat bubble with a play button, clearly signifying a playable message such as an async video walkthrough (Loom, Marco Polo), a voice note, or a voicemail. It fits modern communication and remote-work tasks very well, though at small sizes the bubble's corner tail can be missed and mistaken for a plain video player.
